'''Biblack's Overhaul''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair facility located in the [[Lola Curich Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Run by the retired [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Biblack]], the staff included three assistants and several [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Biblack worked with other smugglers and outlaws, and while his work was fast, he often charged more than the standard rate.<ref name="MTL" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Mission to Lianna]]''
